title: Breathe on Me, Breath of God
lyrics_original: Breathe on me, breath of God,
That I may love what Thou dost love,
And do what Thou wouldst do.
Breathe on me, breath of God,
Until with Thee I will one will,
Breathe on me, breath of God,
Till all this earthly part of me
Breathe on me, breath of God,
But live with Thee the perfect life

bible_verses.english: Thus says the Lord Yahweh to these bones: Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and you will live.
When he had said this, he breathed on them, and said to them, “Receive the Holy Spirit!”
Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a right spirit within me.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord God, breathe Your Holy Spirit fresh upon my heart today. Fill me with Your divine life so that I may love what You love and walk in Your ways. Purify my desires and align my will with Yours, giving me grace both to act and to endure. I surrender myself into Your hands—make me wholly Yours now and always. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: Just as God breathed life into the first creation, He continually invites us to be refreshed by His Holy Spirit. Singing this timeless prayer opens our hearts to align our desires, choices, and endurance with His love. As we yield to His tender presence, He cleanses us from the inside out and restores our joy. May this song be your invitation today to pause, surrender your weariness, and receive the life-giving breath of God anew.
